description: The bar chart illustrates macro F-score values across three frequency categories, showing two side-by-side bars per category corresponding to two methods indicated by the legend (a light peach series labeled “RECA” and a darker orange series with its label obscured). The horizontal axis contains the categorical variable “Frequency” with categories ordered left to right as High, Medium, and Low, while the vertical axis is labeled “Macro f-score” and uses a linear scale from 0 to 1 with regularly spaced tick marks at 0.1 intervals. For the High category, the light peach RECA bar is labeled 0.837 and the darker orange bar is labeled 0.877; for Medium, the RECA bar is labeled 0.538 and the darker orange bar is labeled 0.609; for Low, the RECA bar is labeled 0.114 and the darker orange bar is labeled 0.224. The bars are grouped by frequency category with consistent spacing and no stacking, and each bar includes a numeric value annotation inside the bar; there is no additional visual emphasis such as outlines or callouts beyond the color coding and labels.
